title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice stirred slowly with hot broth, browned mushrooms, white wine and Parmesan until loose and velvety.
equipment: Large heavy saucepan or deep skillet

image.alt: A bowl of creamy mushroom risotto with Parmesan and thyme

steps.text: Warm the broth in the small pot and keep it at a bare simmer.
Heat the oil in the large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms with half the salt, stirring only occasionally, until browned and their liquid has evaporated, {time 8 min}. Set aside.
Lower the heat to medium, add 1 tbsp butter and the shallot and cook until soft, {time 3 min}. Add the garlic and rice and stir until the rice edges look translucent, {time 2 min}.
Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed. Add the thyme, the rest of the salt and a ladle of hot broth, and stir until it is almost absorbed.
Keep adding broth a ladle at a time, stirring often, until the rice is tender with a slight bite and the risotto flows like thick porridge, {time 18-22 min}.
Stir in the mushrooms, the remaining butter and the cheese off the heat. Add a splash more broth to loosen it, cover and rest for {time 2 min}. Serve with parsley.

notes: Risotto should spread slowly on the plate. If it holds its shape in a mound, stir in more broth.
Leftovers make good arancini: roll cold risotto into balls, coat in breadcrumbs and fry.
